title: Chess, But SCP-4975 Is Trying to Crack You
title_history: Chess, But SCP-4975 Cracks Your Pieces (first upload title, per owner)
Chess, But SCP-4975 Is Trying to Crack You (YouTube oEmbed + watch page, 2026-11-26 ~7 PM ET; rendered with zalgo combining marks)
summary: Standard chess vs Stockfish (3600) with a neutral SCP-4975 on e4. After every round it crawls one square to a random free neighbour, then cracks every piece (either colour, kings included) on the 8 squares around it; a piece scanned while already cracked shatters (is removed). A king cracked twice shatters and its side loses. One game in the video: the narrator steers the SCP toward Black, wins material from shattered pieces, then herds the black king (Ra6/Ra7/Rc7 + bishop) next to the SCP, which cracks it twice.
rules: Player White vs Stockfish (3600); standard chess otherwise (castling used at 3:03, queenside castling by the engine 10:16).

SCP-4975 starts on e4 (0:12). It is neutral, cannot be captured, and blocks its square (nothing lands on or passes through it; 6:08 'the SCP would have to move out of the way itself to reveal the king').
Timing: after each full round (after Black's move) it moves one square adjacently (0:19, 4:00, 8:48).

Move choice: uniformly random among the free adjacent squares, any of 8 directions (2:16 'it has eight squares to pick from'; 6:30 'seven possible squares'; 10:00 'two in five chance'). If boxed in it does not move (site rule; video never shows it).
Scan: every piece on the 8 squares around its new square gets cracked, both colours (0:19 cracks d4 and the black c5 pawn).
Second crack = shattered: the piece is captured/removed (0:30, 1:53, 12:03 the d7 bishop 'eliminating it from the board').
Cracks stay on the piece when it moves (13:54 'this knight is once cracked').
King: cracked once, a second scan shatters it and that side loses (2:08 'that would crack my king and then ... would instantly end the game'; 15:30-15:46 win).
Exposed king: if a scan shatters the piece that blocked a check, the king can be captured on the next move (2:34-2:50, 6:03-6:41, 8:07).
win_condition: Checkmate Stockfish, capture its exposed king, or let SCP-4975 crack the black king twice (video win: 15:46). Lose the same ways.
